name: Adapt-Decompress-Draw Rendering Pipeline
aliases: GPU-based Terrain Decoding and Rendering Pipeline
definition: A three-stage rendering pipeline: Adapt (determine visible patches), Decode (GPU geometry shader decompresses patches to buffer), Draw (render decompressed heights as triangles).
summary: The Adapt-Decompress-Draw pipeline renders multiresolution terrain by decoding compressed height data directly into a transform feedback buffer on the GPU, eliminating the need for a persistent geometry cache.
